judgment: It is held up in the king's court,
and trust is cried aloud. There is danger.
Word is announced from the town:
it is not good to go straight to arms.
It is good to set out.
image: The marsh rises to heaven: Deciding.
So the noble one gives out rewards
down to those below; virtue hoarded is taboo.
lines: He is strong in his front toes,
but going when he is not up to it makes shame.
He is strong in his cheekbones: there is misfortune.
But the noble one, decided, decided,
soaked, and vexed, but no harm.
There is no skin on his buttocks,
If a sheep is led along: regret gone.
He hears the words, and does not believe them.
Amaranth on the hill, decided, decided.
If he walks the middle: no harm.
and in the end there is misfortune.

notes.name_en: 夬 is a parting/breaking decision (a fork opened); 'Deciding', not Wilhelm's 'Break-through (Resoluteness)'.
notes.L5: 莧陸 a hill amaranth/pokeweed, thin-rooted and easily cleared — kept as the plant.
